    """In-memory storage for function approval requests.

- `FileBasedFunctionApprovalStorage(storage_path)` — persists `Content` as JSON via `Content.to_dict()`/`from_dict()`, creates intermediate directories in the constructor, survives across instances at the same path, and preserves the embedded function-call name. - `_output_item_to_message` and `_item_to_message` (plus their fan-out helpers `_output_items_to_messages`/`_items_to_messages`) are now `async` and take an optional keyword-only `approval_storage`. All callers `await` them.
